proposed_operation: Transfer a program-level ambiguity-cover motif prior; recipient already enumerates every program separation set and cost.

analytic_identity.definitions: E_D={(h_i,h_j): for all p in D, o_hi(p)=o_hj(p)}; S_D(p)={(h_i,h_j) in E_D: o_hi(p)!=o_hj(p)}.
analytic_identity.result: For every p already in D, S_D(p) is empty by the two definitions. The specified UPDATE therefore cannot recover separation motifs of programs already included in the history.

example_consistency: Equality of complete deterministic outcome vectors is an equivalence relation. The proposed four-cycle ambiguity graph contains ab and ac but omits bc, so it does not follow from the stated definition. A graph restricted to task-relevant pairs could avoid this objection, but is not the specified object.
repair_boundary: Store each program against its pre-observation candidate set instead, or use all initial candidates and a separate pair importance graph. Those repair the empty-set issue but do not by themselves create a new operation; at deployment every target separation set and cost is already explicitly computed.
standard_baseline: Recipient-side weighted version-space splitting / budgeted test cover. The model response itself states that a baseline with the same data and coverage objective subsumes the proposed computation. Source-derived rho could change a prior, but no information or computational advantage was derived or tested.
source_observation_boundary: A single observed source outcome is not a counterfactual outcome vector for all source explanations. Obtaining those vectors requires a stated source hypothesis model, simulations or additional experiments, whose costs must be included.
scope: Assessment of this specific written algorithm, not a general impossibility result for learning or transferring experimental strategies. No native experiment or new learned method was run.
next_operation_requirement: A candidate should expose exactly what source experience constructs that is unavailable from the already-enumerated recipient separation matrix. One next direction is source-learned experiment-generating productions, compared with ordinary program-library learning and matched target-only synthesis; this is an unproven direction, not an accepted method.
